segments.narration: Six hundred nuclear missiles were meant to hide under Greenland. The plan was called Iceworm: four thousand kilometres of tunnels cut into a glacier.
The cover story was science. Camp Century, 1959, a hundred and fifty miles from Thule Air Base, powered by a portable reactor.
Denmark approved a research station on its territory. Denmark was never told about the missiles.
Then the ice began closing in. By mid-1962 the reactor room ceiling had sagged so far it had to be jacked up five feet.

Ice cores showed the sheet moving faster than engineers assumed. The camp was evacuated in 1965 and closed in 1966, and the waste stayed down there. A 2016 study warns the ice above it could start melting by 2100.
